descriptions.g4b_add_named_entry_801dc338: Checks enabled state at176, skips existing named entries by strcmp, obtains a held entry through801de2dc, appends it to external compact list36, assigns name and flags36, then sends every child value to every service in external list48 through slot40. Balances one-pointer output holder on all exits; returns80004005 when disabled, query error when negative, otherwise zero. External lists use opaque storage plus observed four-byte offsets; partial external types are never locally constructed.
